_help: Photo hero images for blog posts. Photos (no text or numbers in them) are in photos/<slug>.jpg; the real, sourced figures are drawn on top by render.js. 'side' is where the figures go. 'og' picks the share-image background: 'hero' (the finished hero) or 'photo' (the bare photo, mirrored if 'og_flip'), with 'og_sub' as its line of text. Run: node tools/blog/heroes/render.js
